channel.title: Wire — Frontend
channel.description: Frontend from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: The Best Way to Use Icons in Web UIs
item.description: What if I told you, you could use CSS to insert and tweak icons without touching any HTML? And that it could be more flexible and maintainable than what you’ve been using? (2 sources: frontendfocus, rubyweekly)

item.title: Crest is a new browser hoping to scratch a similar itch
item.description: Crest is an independent browser for Mac, iPad, and iPhone, made by an Arc user who wanted Spaces, Peek, and the sidebar to have a future. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Lazy Loading Images and Media: How Far Ahead Browsers Fetch
item.description: How far ahead Chrome, Firefox and Safari fetch lazy media, why a lazy hero image slows your page, and where to use lazy, eager and fetchpriority. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: Recursion is DEAD and HTML Killed It
declarative partial updates
item.description: Learn about new out-of-order streaming capabilities and the renewed HTML insertion and streaming methods available in Chrome. (1 source: frontendfocus)

item.title: I Guess I’m Using WebP Now
item.description: After using the same few image formats for 20+ years, I’m now on the WebP bandwagon. That isn’t something I thought I’d ever say. Now I’m wondering how soon it’ll be before I can use a couple more. (1 source: frontendfocus)
